S3 substrate & access.access_model: IAM-gated private bucket with per-consumer scoped GetObject roles
S3 substrate & access.provisioning: User (Paul) provisions via AWS console; pipeline IAM role gains PutObject on this bucket

Versioning scheme.latest_update_mechanism: PutObject overwrite of latest/ on every publish
Versioning scheme.schema_versioning: schema_version semver in hierarchy.schema.json + manifest.json — independent of taxonomy_version and publish date

Contract scope & promises.cadence_promise: Annual recompute + ad-hoc re-publishes for label/contract fixes; consumers poll weekly or subscribe to publish notifications
Contract scope & promises.deprecation_window: 30 days (matches SPS existing 30-day schema-change protocol from SPS CLAUDE.md)
Contract scope & promises.schema_change_communication: CHANGELOG section in docs/hierarchy-contract.md + schema_version semver bump (additive=minor, breaking=major); manifest.json carries schema_version so consumers can detect changes
Contract scope & promises.backwards_compat_policy: Additive fields are always non-breaking (codifies display_name precedent); consumers MUST tolerate unknown fields silently
